gbm_population_evidence.quote: Tumor suspected as glioma (1. Astrocytoma, IDH mutant 2. Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted 3. Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype), meningioma (WHO gr. 1 and gr 2), or brain metastasis based on preliminary diagnosis for which the patient will undergo surgery

candidate_evidence.quote: All patients enrolled in this study will undergo cryoablation as part of their surgical tumor resection procedure.

coder_notes: Procedure-only (cryoablation) feasibility study, Phase NA; no drug or biologic interventions. Population is mixed brain tumours (gliomas incl. glioblastoma IDH-wildtype, meningioma, brain metastases); coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named, basket_gbm_eligible is a possible alternative. IDH and 1p/19q appear only as WHO diagnostic definitions of eligible tumour types, not as selection requirements, so not listed. Newly diagnosed vs recurrent not stated.
